verdict.rationale: Helicone has its own export capability. A user reports they can 'export them all' (all requests) to build a fine-tuning dataset, and the GitHub README advertises a one-line export to PostHog. No evidence shows a native bulk export to blob storage (S3/GCS) or a data warehouse; the REST query API and HQL are only building blocks for that. Missing for 10: documented export connectors to blob storage or data warehouses, scheduled/bulk dataset export docs, export of sessions/traces as a unit, first-party documentation of the bulk export flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse

citations.quote: I like that Helicone allows me to see each request and export them all, so that I can use that to build my fine-tuning dataset.
Export to PostHog in one-line for custom dashboards
